name: VET Student Loans re-credit for special circumstances
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: If circumstances beyond your control stopped you finishing VET units, you can ask your provider to re-credit the VET Student Loan for them.
who: VET Student Loans students whose studies were stopped by circumstances beyond their control that began or got worse after the census day.
how: Apply in writing to your provider, with its application form and supporting evidence, within 12 months of the census day for the units.
catches: Your provider can extend the 12-month limit if you show you couldn't apply in time.
If you disagree with the decision, ask the provider for an internal review, then apply to the Administrative Review Tribunal.

source.label: DEWR: VSL student manual, 24. Special circumstances

evidence.claim: Time limit and who to apply to
evidence.quote: you must apply in writing to your provider within 12 months of the census day for the unit/s.
